title: Environment access and process termination utilities (CodeSaathi extension)
learningObjectives: Explain the topic and its C rules.
Trace the example and explain its data or control flow.
Identify edge cases and resource-management requirements.
Apply the concept in a tested C program.

understand.concept: The standard library provides getenv to inspect environment variables and exit, _Exit and abort for different termination behaviours. Environment values may be absent and should be treated as external input. exit performs normal termination processing, including registered handlers and stream flushing; _Exit does not perform the same cleanup.
understand.whyItMatters: Environment and termination behaviour affect deployment, configuration and cleanup. Programs should not depend on environment variables being present or trusted.
understand.analogy: Treat each algorithm or resource as a contract whose invariants must remain true after every operation.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy does not replace C's formal rules for pointers, object lifetime, complexity or library contracts.

explain.narrative:
The standard library provides getenv to inspect environment variables and exit, _Exit and abort for different termination behaviours. Environment values may be absent and should be treated as external input. exit performs normal termination processing, including registered handlers and stream flushing; _Exit does not perform the same cleanup.

State preconditions, invariants, empty and full cases, ownership and failure behaviour before implementation. Compile with warnings and test normal, boundary and failure paths.

examples.title: Focused C example
examples.explanation: getenv returns a pointer to a string or NULL when the variable is not present. The program supplies a default and returns the standard success status.

practise.guidedTask: Explain why getenv may return NULL and why the returned string should not be modified.
practise.independentTask: Read a configuration variable, validate its allowed values and choose a documented fallback.
hints: Do not store secrets in environment variables without considering the deployment threat model.
The pointer returned by getenv must not be freed by the caller.
Use EXIT_SUCCESS and EXIT_FAILURE for portable status intent.
